messages:
Anika - CS: Heads-up — Kivern (trial account) wants to onboard a private 70B summarizer into our Private offering. They need HSM for keys, VPC, and per-route latency SLA. Can someone take lead on feasibility + safety eval? :eyes:

Devon - Solutions Eng: I can scope infra and perf. Quick Q: will they accept a 13b fallback for burst? If not, capacity planning gets heavier.

Anika - CS: They explicitly said no fallback — product team needs consistent 50–150ms at 512 tokens. Renewal looks tied to hitting that SLA next quarter.

Linus - AE: adding context — contract renewal discussion starts in 45 days. If we don't confirm capacity + safety gating, risk of churn.

Priya - Safety: @Devon + @Anika — need data access & red-team criteria. We'll run an eval suite: PII extraction, hallucination regression, prompt-injection. Can you provide representative prompt samples and top failure modes?

Anika - CS: sharing samples now — pasted below. Also they want custom prompt templates and user-provided adapters.

Anika - CS: ```
user_prompt = "Summarize the medical visit and highlight PHI items for billing. Keep <150 tokens."
adapt_config = { "preserve_entities": true, "vendor_labels": ["diag_code"] }
```

Devon - Solutions Eng: perf wise, 70B on private infra with HSM is doable but needs 4x A100s or equivalent + our KV cache warmup. Will put together a capacity sketch and cost delta.

Priya - Safety: For the eval harness, give us a small seed set (1000 records) with red-team pairs. We'll run baseline on their current model and ours, compare precision/recall on entity scrubbing.

Anika - CS: I'll ask Kivern for the seed set and sign-off for a limited eval copy. Also flagged CSM Triage to collect feedback during the canary window.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy check: private cluster quota available in us-west-2 for 3 nodes. ETA: 2 days.

Devon - Solutions Eng: I'll draft a runbook with perf targets, canary steps, and rollback triggers. Sharing by EOD.

Linus - AE: If we can commit to a 30-day pilot with metrics visibility (latency/cost/quality), I can push renewal conversation later and reduce churn risk.

Anika - CS: sweet. @Priya can you own safety pass? @Devon own infra sketch? @Linus manage renewal ask? I'll coordinate with Kivern and collect the seed data.

Priya - Safety: Yep — I'll own safety pass and share eval checklist.

Devon - Solutions Eng: On it. I'll post draft infra/cost in this thread when ready.

Anika - CS: thanks team :raised_hands:
